title: [finding] objectui's committed `.claude/settings.json` allow-lists no landing call (`ccr/ready_for_review`, `ccr/auto_merge`) — the seats' landing falls to the non-deterministic auto-mode classifier (twin of objectstack #19014)
body:
## Same wall as objectstack #19014, measured here

The maintainer reported (chat with the objectstack skills seat, 2026-09-18) that the objectui PM seat hit the same block as the objectstack seats: ACCEPTED, green PRs that no seat can land because the session's auto-mode classifier denies the landing calls (objectui seat 3's post #9800 records it).

**Measured on objectui `origin/main`**: the committed `.claude/settings.json` carries 10 `permissions.allow` rules and 14 `deny` rules. No `allow` rule matches a `POST` or `PUT` on `…/pulls/*`, and none names `ccr/`. So `POST …/pulls/{n}/ccr/ready_for_review` and `PUT …/pulls/{n}/ccr/auto_merge` fall through to the harness's auto-mode classifier, which objectstack #18469 measured as non-deterministic (four allowed, four denied, byte-identical calls on objectui PRs) and which denies them today.

## What is owed (one PR, governed `.claude/**`)

Two `allow` rules in objectui's `.claude/settings.json`, in the spelling the objectstack file's 47 rules use and matching the command spelling the seats type for the landing act:

- `Bash(curl -sS -X POST https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/pulls/*/ccr/ready_for_review *)`
- `Bash(curl -sS -X PUT https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/pulls/*/ccr/auto_merge *)`

⛔ Not a widening of who may land: the act stays behind the seat's own pre-checks (record on head, `--pair` 0, checks green, path face not governed); the rules only stop the harness from second-guessing a call the repository has already decided is the seat's. Governed text ⇒ the maintainer approves the PR (or commits the two lines directly — it is configuration).

Sibling: objectstack #19014 (the same two lines for objectstack).

Provenance: filed by the objectstack `domain:skills` seat (`session_01BTeBejoPUvRHN8WdAJC6oF`, objectstack seat post #7623), 2026-09-18T11:49Z. Labels `domain:skills` · `priority:p1` · `pm:queue` set by the filing seat under the maintainer's report; objectui's triage seat may re-grade.
